target.definition: Number of new passenger cars (Pkw) registered in Germany in September 2026, as first reported by the KBA monthly press release.

inputs.name: annual_new_pkw_registrations
inputs.description: Total new passenger car registrations in Germany in 2026 (full year)

provenance.rationale: Recent annual totals ~2.6-2.9M; 2026 expected similar with slight EV recovery

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual new car registrations occurring in September

provenance.rationale: September is historically a strong month due to new plate year and quarter-end push; ~8-9% of annual

inputs.name: monthly_baseline_registrations
inputs.description: Average monthly new passenger car registrations in Germany in 2026

inputs.name: september_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: Multiplicative factor for September relative to average month

provenance.rationale: September typically slightly above average due to new model year and quarter-end incentives

inputs.name: daily_registration_rate
inputs.description: Average new passenger car registrations per working day in Germany in 2026

provenance.rationale: Annual ~2.8M over ~250 working days gives ~11k, but recent monthly averages suggest ~9k per working day

inputs.name: working_days_september
inputs.description: Number of working days in September 2026 (Mon-Fri excluding public holidays)

provenance.rationale: September 2026 has 22 weekdays; no federal holidays except possibly regional

inputs.name: september_working_day_factor
inputs.description: Factor adjusting September daily rate relative to annual average daily rate

provenance.rationale: September daily rate similar to annual average

inputs.name: annual_cars_per_1000_people
inputs.description: New passenger car registrations per 1000 people per year in Germany

inputs.name: september_share_of_year
inputs.description: Fraction of year represented by September

inputs.name: september_seasonal_index
inputs.description: Seasonal index for September relative to average month (1.0 = average)

paths.description: Annual registrations allocated to September by seasonal share
Monthly baseline times September seasonal factor
Daily rate times working days in September
